waiver.quote: (a) Registrations shall expire on the last day of June following issuance or renewal and shall become invalid after that date unless renewed.

symmetry.label: Binds individuals harder than institutions
symmetry.qe: The Board may revoke or suspend the certificate of registration of any registrant who it finds has committed gross negligence, fraud, deceit or flagrant misconduct in the practice of forestry or has demonstrated incompetence as a practicing forester.
